 Pang Ron-Pei Jing storm into Korea Open quarters
 Pang Ron-Pei Jing storm into Korea Open quarters
 05-Nov-2026, 10:55 05 Nov 2026, 10:55 K. Parkaran Share The fast-rising Malaysian mixed doubles pair beat a home combination in straight games to reach the last eight.
 Hoo Pang Ron-Lai Pei Jing made a remarkable rise in the world rankings, climbing from No 460 to their current position of No 15. (Bernama pic) 
 PETALING JAYA : Fast-rising mixed doubles pair Hoo Pang Ron-Lai Pei Jing continued their impressive run of form today, storming into the Korea Open quarter-finals. 
 The Malaysians, who only began partnering in May, beat South Korea’s Jin Sung Ik-Lee Seung Hee 21-8, 21-15 in 32 minutes to advance to the last eight.
 The pair have made a remarkable rise in the world rankings, climbing from No 460 to their current position of No 15.
 They will face either Chinese top seeds and world No 2 Jiang Zhen Bang-Wei Ya Xin or Japan’s Haruki Kawabe-Kokona Ishikawa in the quarter-finals tomorrow.
 Pang Ron-Pei Jing have reached five semi-finals in the 10 World Tour tournaments they contested this year, finishing runners-up at the Super 750 French Open and China Masters.
 Meanwhile, mixed doubles combination Chen Tang Jie-Chan Wen Tse crashed out in the second round, losing 7-21, 13-21 to China’s third seeds and world No 8 Cheng Xing-Zhang Chi in 29 minutes.
